description: This file defines the Serbian (Latin, Serbia) culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and related utility functions. It customizes date parsing and formatting behavior for the specified locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing today's date with time cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two dates, returns -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a named timezone.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Checks if the date falls between two dates.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the date is after another date.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the date is before another date.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if the date is today.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks if this date is the same day as another.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds seconds to the date.

methods.name: addMinutes

methods.name: addWeeks
